idea: How to stop checking your phone at work
text:
You’re staring at your screen again [pause], and it’s not helping [look at camera]. Here’s the thing: your focus is slipping [serious tone].

You’ll learn how to stay present without touching your phone [confident tone]. This is possible [pause].

First I’ll set a timer for twenty minutes [gesture], then I’ll write down one task [pause], and finally I’ll close the app [motion toward phone].

Now save this so you can try step one tomorrow [pause]. This helps a lot [smile].
title: Stop Checking Your Phone at Work
